summary: Iteration 4 E2E: pricing removal from homepage, hero H1 rewrite, strategy-call popup with conditional fields, WhatsApp+Call FABs, admin SEO manager, GEO (llms.txt), and full regression smoke. Backend pytest 10/10 pass (test_pytech_iter4.py). Frontend flows verified on desktop 1920 and mobile 390: homepage has NO ₹/$ in what-we-do cards, no id='pricing' section, no 'Starting prices'; hero H1 = 'We build apps & websites, run your marketing & automate with AI.' (contains apps/websites/marketing/automate). Book-Strategy-Call popup opens from navbar link + hero button; selecting Website reveals bc-pages, Mobile App reveals bc-apptype (and hides bc-pages); budget bc-budget is a blank free-text input. Blank submit -> 'Please add your name and email' toast, no lead. Full submit -> success view 'Request received 🎉' AND lead persisted via GET /api/leads with source='strategy-call-popup', projectType='Website', pages='9 pages + blog', budget='TEST budget 2L'. WhatsApp FAB bottom-left (wa.me/919711623561), Call FAB bottom-right (tel:+919711623561) — both visible desktop & mobile, no overlap. Admin SEO manager: password login, tab-seo lists all 10 pages, selected /pricing, saved TEST override -> 'SEO saved — live on the page now' toast -> confirmed via HTML: <title>TEST_UI Admin Pricing SEO</title> (exact, no site-name suffix), meta description matches -> cleared override -> default title 'Pricing — Website, App, ERP, AI Automation & Marketing | PyTech Digital' returns. GET /api/seo -> 401 without admin key, 200 with (10 pages returned). PUT /api/seo -> 401 without key. /llms.txt -> text/plain with PyTech Digital, 6 offerings + INR/USD starting prices + contact + sitemap link. /sitemap.xml 200 contains /pricing. Homepage HTML contains ItemList JSON-LD (@type:ItemList). Regression: /, /services, /services/web-development, /pricing, /work, /careers, /case-studies, /locations, /ai-automation, /resources, /support, /admin all 200 (with retry on transient 502s from Next JIT compile). Mobile 390x844: popup fully scrollable, all inputs within viewport (x>=0, right edge<=400), no horizontal overflow on /pricing (0px). All test data (leads + seo overrides) cleaned up via mongosh.
critical_code_review_comments: BookCallDialog global document click-intercept relies on data-book-call OR a[href='/#contact']. There's no data-book-call attribute anywhere in the DOM (verified) — only the href match works. Consider adding data-book-call on the navbar Button/hero Button so the intercept is explicit and future refactors that change the href don't silently break the popup.

Clicking the navbar 'Book Strategy Call' link still hash-navigates to /#contact under the popup because the anchor's default is prevented on click but the browser may still process hashchange in some cases. Consider making these buttons instead of <a href='/#contact'> and using data-book-call — cleaner, keeps URL clean and avoids scrolling behind the modal.

route.js /api/seo PUT accepts empty title/description/keywords and stores an empty doc rather than deleting the doc. Works but leaves dead rows. Consider deleteOne when all fields are blank (or add a DELETE endpoint).
lib/mongo.js and api/[[...path]]/route.js both maintain their own Mongo client cache — DRY violation. Consolidate to a single shared client to avoid double connection pools per Next server process.

pricing/page.js defines BASE_METADATA AFTER generateMetadata references it. Works today because of const hoisting to declaration + runtime call, but is fragile — declare BASE_METADATA before generateMetadata for clarity.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Popup lead via backend POST, TEST_UI popup lead via UI, and TEST SEO overrides on /pricing (twice). All deleted at end via mongosh: db.leads.deleteMany({email:/test.*popup@example.com/}) and db.seo.deleteMany({}). Final DB state: 6 default offerings, no test rows in leads/seo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: External URL: https://verified-build-6.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin key header 'x-admin-key: pytech-admin-2026'. /api/leads GET returns a raw array (not {leads:[]}) — code the assertion accordingly. Popup can be opened via document-level click intercept on either [data-book-call] OR any a[href='/#contact']|a[href='#contact']; there are currently no [data-book-call] elements, only the href anchors. Book-call navbar link exact text is 'Book Strategy Call' (no 'a'); hero button text is 'Book a Strategy Call'. Both /pricing 'Get a quote' link uses href='/#contact' so same intercept applies. Transient 502s can happen on first hit to /ai-automation and /resources due to Next JIT — always retry with a 2s backoff. SEO PUT with all blank fields keeps a blank row (see code review). Cleanup: db.leads and db.seo collections in db 'pytech_digital'.
